title: Hey guys, I'm new here! What do you think about the beginning of the trailer of our first TCG mobile game project? It’s made using AI (Dalle3, Leonardo, Runway) with several (ok many) manual modifications.
author: OblivionMechanics

comments.author: VariableVeritas
comments.body:
Trailers without gameplay make me pretty sure the gameplay sucks. Slicker the video sans gameplay the worse the feels. So, even though I get you’re probably pre-gameplay footage my first peice of advice is to be sure you include it once you have it.

Good luck out there.

replies.author: OblivionMechanics
replies.body:
Thanks!!!

Yeah, gameplay is crucial and we'll show it as you say. This time you're watching the first part of a lore cinematic :)

replies.author: VariableVeritas
replies.body:
You can start a long lore trailer, it can be 9/10ths of the time. Keep it focused on the plot, also an important factor in games and the thing which makes lasting mental impact.

If it’s an ‘advertisement’ for the game it must include something that people can expect to see in the game.

replies.author: OblivionMechanics
replies.body: Thank you for the recommendations! I'll take them 100%. I have some interesting screenshots that show how the game is going to look like so I'll try to do something with that and I'll be back :)

comments.author: WillowKisz
comments.body: Instinctively made me think it's a clickbait game
